source.truth: The upstream project contains 50 terminal skins, not 50 completed image worlds.

worlds.title: Neon Ghost District
worlds.environment: A haunted data metropolis suspended over a black digital abyss
worlds.architecture: transparent server towers, spectral rails, fractured hologram bridges
worlds.landmark: the Ghost Relay, a colossal flickering transmission spire
worlds.atmosphere: hot magenta plasma, cyan whispers, drifting code fragments

worlds.title: Chrome Rain Ward

worlds.landmark: the Mercury Exchange, a liquid-metal civic tower
worlds.atmosphere: electric blue rain, hot pink signage, acid-yellow warnings

worlds.title: Corrupted Signal Block

worlds.landmark: the Packet Rupture, a building split into repeating digital slices

worlds.title: Void Sunset Promenade

worlds.landmark: the Last Channel, a horizon-wide abandoned antenna ring
worlds.atmosphere: violet haze, tangerine light, seafoam data surf
motion: data waves roll across the ground

red alert glyphs ignite along the vault
